sql: SELECT i.unit, i.provider, i.status, i.phone_number, (SELECT count(*) FROM sales_materials m WHERE m.unit = i.unit AND m.is_active AND m.company_id = i.company_id) AS materiais, (SELECT count(*) FROM wapi_conversations c WHERE c.instance_id = i.id AND c.last_message_at > now() - interval '7 days') AS conversas_7d, (SELECT json_build_object('bot', s.bot_enabled, 'flow', s.use_flow_builder, 'teste', s.test_mode_enabled) FROM wapi_bot_settings s WHERE s.instance_id = i.id) AS bot FROM wapi_instances i WHERE i.company_id = 'a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001' ORDER BY i.unit
